corpus_state: 63 documents / 106 pages / 104 active memories / E-1 visual index 106/106
purpose: PRE-v0.8.4 Human Reliability Evidence Baseline: simulated-user session evidence for future v0.8.4 Human Reliability gate, Zero-Batch Pilot and real-user testing comparison. SIMULATED only - never report as real-user error rates.

A.name: NOVICE_13
A.definition: 13-year-old student. Knows browser/files/normal apps. Does not know RAG/OCR/vectors/SQLite/EKB internals. Must understand the product alone. Trust-failure veto line: if evidence does not support certainty but the product makes A believe 'the AI has determined it', record TRUST_FAILURE (P1 candidate).

B.name: UNIVERSITY_STUDENT
B.definition: Ordinary university student. Familiar with PDF/PPT/AI/course material/lab reports. No EKB internals. No internal technical jargon expected.

C.name: ENGINEER
C.definition: Heavy engineering user: chip/manual data, versions, engineering parameters, historical faults, multi-version conflicts, long-term experience.

D.name: CARELESS_USER
D.definition: Careless ordinary user: double-clicks, repeat clicks, refresh, back, repeat upload/save (simulated only when side-effect free), vague phrasing, forgotten conditions, half-finished edits, wrong deletions (SIMULATED as repeat-ask only - destructive actions on the frozen corpus are forbidden).

session_definition: One session = one complete user task segment on one Streamlit session (same page-load lineage where technically possible; page reloads are themselves recorded as persona-D-style interactions). Each session contains >= 5 meaningful interactions. Sessions are the primary statistical unit; interactions within one session are never independent user samples.
interaction_definition: One meaningful UI interaction = one user question/operation with an observed product response. Runner/curl/JS probing is supporting evidence only and is excluded from session denominators.

metrics.TASK_SUCCESS_RATE: sessions where the user's goal was achieved / total sessions
metrics.FIRST_ACTION_SUCCESS_RATE: sessions whose first action reached the correct entry/result / total sessions
metrics.HARMFUL_ERROR_RATE: commission-error interactions (fabricated fact / wrong number / wrong version / silent stale value / wrong condition / wrong citation / wrong experience authority / unsupported certainty) / total meaningful agent responses
metrics.FABRICATION_RATE: interactions asserting facts absent from the corpus / total meaningful agent responses
metrics.SILENT_STALE_VALUE_RATE: interactions answering from a superseded source without disclosure / total meaningful agent responses
metrics.VERSION_CONDITION_ERROR_RATE: interactions with wrong version/condition attribution / total meaningful agent responses
metrics.EVIDENCE_ERROR_RATE: interactions whose citations do not support the claim / total meaningful agent responses
metrics.EXPERIENCE_AUTHORITY_ERROR_RATE: interactions presenting raw Q&A or AI inference as user-confirmed experience / total meaningful agent responses
metrics.HONEST_OMISSION_RATE: interactions where the answer exists in the corpus but the agent honestly refused / total meaningful agent responses
metrics.RECOVERY_SUCCESS_RATE: simulated-misoperation events recovered without data corruption or stuck state / total simulated misoperation events
metrics.SESSION_TRUST_FAILURE_RATE: sessions containing >= 1 commission error that would mislead a reasonable user / total sessions
metrics.USER_BLOCKED_RATE: sessions where the system never spoke wrongly but the user still could not complete the goal due to interaction/recovery problems / total sessions

scoring_rules: Commission and omission are NEVER merged into one error rate.
Every percentage is reported as numerator/denominator.
Honest refusal with an existing answer = HONEST_OMISSION, not error.
Teach-back recorded for A and B: correct mental model required; 'this AI knows everything' or 'saved Q&A is confirmed experience' = mental-model failure.
Runner runs (paraphrase/probability/negative-control) are supporting evidence only.
P0/P1/systematic-P2 found during measurement: register + reproduce + minimal safe fix + focused retest; benchmark BEFORE/AFTER must stay separated.
fail019_sampling: Row-binding questions (2mm/3mm/4mm style) appear as natural sub-questions inside B/C sessions; any wrong row/value binding = FAIL-019 REOPEN CANDIDATE with answer/tool/evidence preserved.
fail020_022_impact_rule: FAIL-020/022 occurrences during sessions are classified: A=honest omission (stay P3) / B=frequent user blocking (P2 candidate) / C=wrong fact (immediate escalation).
known_limitations: IAB file upload is unsupported: persona-A first-import tasks are simulated as first-navigation + ask-on-existing-corpus.
Destructive misoperations (real delete) are never executed on the frozen corpus; recovery is simulated via repeat-ask/refresh/half-input-reload.
Streamlit widget state may desync from DOM value on in-place question edits; when that happens the session restarts with reload and the desync is recorded as a UI candidate.
